outputs.explanation: This is a macroscopic photograph of intestines, not a plot.
This is a micrograph (H&E staining), not a plot.
The top part of panel C is a box plot showing total polyp number per mouse across genotypes; box plots already display the data distribution and are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
The bottom part of panel C is a 3D bar chart showing mean polyp number per mouse by diameter category and genotype, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
This is a Kaplan-Meier survival line plot; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
The bar chart quantifying GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 levels shows only mean bars with error bars, without any overlaid individual data points.
This panel contains immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a plot.
The 'Relative expression' bar chart quantifying Asef, pJNK1 and MMP9 levels shows only mean bars with error bars and no individual data points overlaid.
